items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Yeah, Manuel was leading my band once.

ctx.x: Did Manuel Perez ever play in his band? You played with Manuel several times, huh? Who Manuel? Manuel Perez.
Yeah, Manuel was leading my band once. I asked what the name of that band?
What was the name of that band when Manuel was the leader?
